summary: Implemented the rich.progress open/wrap_file feature. Changes: rich/progress.py (private _ProgressReader and _ProgressReaderContext, private helper _make_reading_progress, module-level open and wrap_file, Progress.open and Progress.wrap_file with overloads); tests/test_progress.py (new tests for module-level open/wrap_file, Progress.open/wrap_file, byte accounting, seek/tell, write refusal, error cases); docs/source/progress.rst (two new sections); CHANGELOG.md (one Unreleased/Added entry, no PR link). Diff is additive only. Tests, mypy, and black were not run, per the instructions. Deviations: Progress.open opens the file before creating the task so a failed open leaves no stray task; the module-level functions and Progress methods accept str-typed modes via fallback overloads. Caveat: module-level open/wrap_file open the file at call time, so an unentered context leaves the handle open until GC.
